groups.reason: The discussion concerns an associated object from Vindristjarna, but the marked span does not clearly isolate a complete ship-name replacement. Repair would risk reconstructing missing ordinary wording.

The comparison with a creature stronger than the defeated dragons strongly favors Cha'mutte, whose documented pronunciation matches the marked form. An incidental real-world Shamu reference is less consistent with this power comparison.
Wellby is enumerating his languages; the reference establishes Eastros as a trade language.

The dialogue calls someone the gaseous-form person, but searches of character notes, campaign records, and relevant DM material did not establish a unique identity for Jersey. Retain rather than infer a caster from mechanics.

The absent crew member strongly favors Kethra: the earlier dialogue places her with Riswynn, and Session 103 explicitly records their joint departure. Heather has no matching crew identity in the inspected sources.
The pirate clone and Illoria references identify the Nevos Sea; the geographic reference and preceding session agree.

These spans are descriptive fragments, conversational wording, or rules/planning language rather than isolated recoverable names. Florida Desert occurs in a damaged statement about how long the land has been desert; part of the fang and follow dwarf likewise require phrase reconstruction.
The dwarven city where Riswynn has gone to confront her duplicate is Tharn Todor; the reference note and previous session establish the complete name.

Wellby is listing his languages, and Session 94 records the party learning Urskan. Languages has a transposed Urksan heading flagged as inconsistent; the campaign record establishes the form used here.
